name: Corn vs Soybean: Price Levels, YoY Context & Ratio Decomposition
description: Research study analyzing Corn (ZC) and Soybean (ZS) futures across two panels: (1) Absolute price levels with indexed comparison, per-asset current vs 1-year-ago overlays, and a summary table of current price, price 1Y ago, YoY % change, 52-week high/low; (2) Ratio decomposition showing each commodity's indexed price vs the ZC/ZS ratio indexed to 100, plus a summary of YoY changes to identify which leg drives the discount. Uses futures_continuation with BackwardPanamaCanal adjustment. ZS loaded via reference_futures.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN VS SOYBEAN: PRICE LEVELS, YoY CONTEXT & RATIO DECOMPOSITION
# =============================================================================
# Panel 1 - Absolute price levels & YoY context:
#   - cs_lines: ZC and ZS indexed to 100 (comparable scale)
#   - xy_lines (per-asset): Current price vs 1-year-ago overlay
#   - cs_summary_table: Current price, price 1Y ago, YoY %, 52-week high/low
#
# Panel 2 - Ratio decomposition (which leg drives the ZC/ZS ratio):
#   - xy_lines on ZC: Corn indexed + ZC/ZS ratio indexed (both to 100)
#   - xy_lines on ZS: Soy indexed + ZC/ZS ratio indexed (both to 100)
#   - summary_table per-asset: ZC YoY %, ZS YoY %, ratio YoY %
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
# ZC (Corn) - primary asset via market_data_source
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# ZS (Soybean) - reference via reference_futures + continuation
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)
close_zs = zs_cont.c

# --- Timestamps for charts ---
bar_ts = index()

# --- Common calculations ---
# 1-year-ago price (252 trading days)
close_1y_ago = close >> 252
close_zs_1y_ago = close_zs >> 252

# YoY % change
yoy_chg = (close - close_1y_ago) / close_1y_ago
yoy_chg_zs = (close_zs - close_zs_1y_ago) / close_zs_1y_ago

# 52-week (252 day) high and low
high_52w = max(period=252)(close)
low_52w = min(period=252)(close)
high_52w_zs = max(period=252)(close_zs)
low_52w_zs = min(period=252)(close_zs)

# --- ZC/ZS Ratio ---
ratio = close / close_zs
ratio_1y_ago = close_1y_ago / close_zs_1y_ago
ratio_yoy = (ratio - ratio_1y_ago) / ratio_1y_ago

# --- Indexed prices (to 100 at ~2 years ago = 504 bars) ---
# Use valuewhen-like approach: divide by the value 504 bars ago * 100
close_504 = close >> 504
close_zs_504 = close_zs >> 504
ratio_504 = ratio >> 504

indexed_close = (close / close_504) * 100
indexed_zs = (close_zs / close_zs_504) * 100
indexed_ratio = (ratio / ratio_504) * 100

# =============================================================================
# PANEL 1: ABSOLUTE PRICE LEVELS & YOY CONTEXT
# =============================================================================

# 1a. cs_lines: Both ZC and ZS indexed to 100 for comparable scale
cs_lines(
    title='Corn vs Soybean — Indexed Price (Base 100)',
    category='1. Price Levels & YoY',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Value',
    order=1
)(bar_ts, indexed_close)

# 1b. Per-asset xy_lines: Current price vs 1-year-ago overlay
xy_lines(
    title='Current Price vs 1 Year Ago',
    category='1. Price Levels & YoY',
    y_axis_label='Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Current Price', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Price 1 Year Ago', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, close, close_1y_ago)

# 1c. cs_summary_table: Current price, price 1Y ago, YoY %, 52-week high, 52-week low
cs_summary_table(
    title='Price Summary',
    category='1. Price Levels & YoY',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Price Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Price 1Y Ago', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='YoY Change', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='52-Week High', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='52-Week Low', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(close, close_1y_ago, yoy_chg, high_52w, low_52w)

# =============================================================================
# PANEL 2: RATIO DECOMPOSITION — WHICH LEG DRIVES THE DISCOUNT
# =============================================================================

# Identify which asset we're on, to show the right per-asset chart
is_zc = is_asset_ref(ticker='ZC')()

# Corn's indexed price vs ratio indexed (per-asset on ZC)
corn_indexed_for_chart = where(is_zc, indexed_close)
ratio_indexed_for_zc = where(is_zc, indexed_ratio)

xy_lines(
    title='Corn Price vs ZC/ZS Ratio (Indexed to 100)',
    category='2. Ratio Decomposition',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Value (Base 100)',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Corn Price (Indexed)', color=Color.Amber),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZC/ZS Ratio (Indexed)', color=Color.Indigo, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, indexed_close, indexed_ratio)

# Per-asset summary table: ZC YoY %, ZS YoY %, Ratio YoY %
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='YoY Changes — Ratio Decomposition',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=3,
        col_headers=['ZC (Corn) YoY', 'ZS (Soy) YoY', 'ZC/ZS Ratio YoY'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. Ratio Decomposition',
    order=2
)(yoy_chg, yoy_chg_zs, ratio_yoy)
